data.one_liner: Dart port of Quill Delta JSON format for rich-text documents
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart implementation of the Quill Delta format, enabling creation, manipulation, and diffing of rich-text documents in JSON.
use_when: You need to serialize or deserialize Quill Delta documents in a Dart/Flutter app
You want to compute diffs between two Delta objects
You are building a rich-text editor that uses the Quill Delta format
avoid_when: You only need a simple text editor without Delta support
You are working exclusively with Flutter widgets that already handle rich text
